translation_direction: ru → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Russian electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Tolstoy’s deliberate repetitions and anaphora are kept rather than varied for elegance.
decisions.rationale: The relentless plain syntax is the novella’s voice.

decisions.decision: Tolstoy’s French and Latin phrases (le phénix de la famille, respice finem, comme il faut, établissement) stay untranslated, as in the original; the 1984 edition’s editorial footnotes are not reproduced.
decisions.rationale: The foreign phrases mark the class register Tolstoy satirises.

decisions.decision: Ivan Ilyich is anh in chapter II before his marriage and ông afterwards; Praskovya Fyodorovna nàng then bà; husband and wife use tôi/anh, with em in tender moments.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The key sentence on the ‘most simple and ordinary and most terrible’ life restored to Tolstoy’s grouping.
Garbled doubled appositive in the funeral chapter recast; 106, 122, 173 and 317 smoothed.
встряхнулась, установившуюся было, the doctor’s neutral этого доктора, and the cause clause in 225 corrected.
Cross-part consistency: the doctor’s address, обед/ужин (bữa chiều / bữa ăn khuya), роббер, сцены, Gerasim’s pronoun cậu, đi-văng and quotation punctuation unified.
Gerasim’s switch to ты is now audible in his line.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: nhẹ nhàng, dễ chịu và đứng đắn
glossary.rationale: Tolstoy’s ironic formula is rendered identically wherever it recurs, singly or together; прилично/приличие is always đứng đắn.

glossary.source_term: Она (the pain, death); не то; черный мешок
glossary.draft_rendering: Nó; Không phải thế; cái bao đen
glossary.rationale: The personified pain is capitalised Nó once it ‘comes and stands before him’; the key words of the final chapters are fixed.

glossary.draft_rendering: tha cho / cho qua; Hết rồi cái chết. Nó không còn nữa.
glossary.rationale: The near-homophone slip and the final reversal are kept.

glossary.draft_rendering: Gerasim: con / ông chủ; Ivan Ilyich: cậu
glossary.rationale: Peasant deference and the master’s familiarity; Gerasim’s switch to ты is shown by dropping the deferential pronoun.

witness_decision: Selected the Russian Wikisource page «Смерть Ивана Ильича (Толстой)» (revision 5726104), transcribed from az.lib.ru in modern orthography and marked 75% (proofread) quality; its commentary identifies the base as Л. Н. Толстой, Собрание сочинений в 12 томах, т. 11 (Москва: Правда, 1984). First published in Сочинения гр. Л. Н. Толстого, ч. 12 (Москва, 1886); not collated with a print facsimile.

unresolved_questions.explanation: «ничто не тяжело, ничто не легче» is compressed.

title_review.rationale: Cái chết của Ivan Ilyich is the established Vietnamese title and matches the body’s cái chết for смерть.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Opening of chapter II keeps its three superlatives.
Ending keeps «Кончена смерть… Ее нет больше» and the dateline.
